title: Virtual Hypertension Management Pilot
brief_summary: Investigators are examining the quality improvement impact of providing patients with a an electronic health record-connected blood pressure cuff. Investigators will give half of patients already eligible for hypertension management within a clinical pharmacist panel, the ability to upload their blood pressure data into Stanford's electronic health record.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hypertension as defined by clinical pharmacist usual care panel (2 or more readings of blood pressure \>140/90)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Chronic kidney disease III or IV
* Systolic heart failure with ejection fraction \<35%
* Current use of 3 or more anti-hypertension drugs
